text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—— It's really starting to come together
now. 
At this rate,
I think we can successfully perform 
the abridged version for the ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's call it a day for now. Tomorrow,
we'll continue 
with full rehearsals,
so give it your best.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The steps… angle of arms…! 
Down to my fingertips…!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are,
Kawakami. Were you here all night long……? 
She seems really focused… I guess I shouldn't
disturb her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hm…… Seems like she's pretty worked up. … Well, I understand the sentiment though.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah… I mean,
she's filling in for someone she 
always admired,
of course she's pumped up. 
—— We should also put in more effort!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Can't lose to Kawaka— Ah,
right! Do you think there 
could be materials from past Votive Stage
Plays lying around? 
It could really help us with our acting!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm～ This is a script for a different play…
And this one's… 
I'm not quite sure! ……Ah,
I wonder what this disc is for.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It says "Shirabyōshi"!
It might be a video of 
an old performance!! Let's take a look!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
………… Ah,
I knew it!
This is the Votive Stage Play ——

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —— Wait! Prez!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wow! What is this,
what is this?! The president's in it!! 
Why?! And on top of that,
this is… a butterfly costume!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? So, are we playing the same role!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the lines… They're the same, but… 
Did this scene always have such intense 
energy and impactful movements……?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wow… It's divine, mysterious,
mesmerizing… 
It's so… butterfly-like……

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ……… So cool.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
…… The atmosphere in the venue was
incredible. I mean,
you can even feel it from the footage… It's
like 
there's something touching me deep in my
heart……

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
———— Ah!! I see,
so this is what the president 
tried to tell me about the other day…!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So, I went shopping with the president a
little 
while ago, and on the way back home ——

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We were talking about how it's almost
time 
for the Festival of Illustrious Equines.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
She said the Festival is a very meaningful
event to horsegirls, 
so they put a lot of effort into its
management.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That by having the next generation understand
and carry on its rituals,
she hopes the Festival of Illustrious Equines,
which prays for all horsegirls' futures,
continues to be lively.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Particularly this year,
because Tracen Academy is responsible 
for a significant ritual,
she's eager to give it her all, and she 
has high hopes as well……

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because the president has
personally 
participated in the ceremony before… That's
why 
she has a strong desire to pass it on……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see… Yeah, I think so too. 
It's something special to Prez…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
…… Wait. Are you going behind my back,
Tsuru!? 
Doing things like shopping together and
having 
important conversations! That's not fair!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaa～!?
I didn't mean for it to happen that way,
it was pure coincidence!
We just happened to bump into each 
other at the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
…… But honestly,
now that I think about it, 
I'm glad we did. I got to hear her story.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—— I want to carry on that legacy.
If someone is going to keep 
the President's vision alive,
I'd like to be that person.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I definitely want to do the Votive Stage
Play ——

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —— In "traditional" form……!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: O mighty and revered three pillars, witness my dance till its end…!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My essence carries my mentor's legacy and the solemnity of the pillars. I am the vessel of ancestral wisdom, pledging to prolong their esteemed heritage——!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh…! My footwork still needs a lot of
improvement…! 
Madam King, on the other hand,
moves so naturally, 
just like flowing water……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
………Take a half step back right here… then
pivot. 
Keep my gaze focused… mind my elbow
placement 
and fingertips………

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Half step back, pivot, focused gaze, elbows,
fingertips… 
Half step back, pivot, focused gaze, elbows,
fingertips……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Alright! Once more, from the start! O mighty and revered three pillars ——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Draw near, draw near, heed the resolve I have set in my heart…!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That girl,
still practicing at this hour………

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Despite the burden I've put on her,
she remains 
so focused… That kid's got real
determination. 
I'm sure she'll pull through again…)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm sure……… She will……
